findings.claim: BX 10-K 風險因素自述：AI 技術可能大幅顛覆其商業模式、投資策略、營運流程與所處市場，並使 BX 及投組公司面臨更高競爭、法律監管風險與合規成本；部分同業在 AI 平台上可能比 BX 更成功。
findings.excerpt: AI Technologies could significantly disrupt the business models, investment strategies, operational processes, and markets in which we operate. Similarly, AI Technologies could significantly disrupt our portfolio companies’ businesses and markets.

findings.claim: Morningstar：對 AI 顛覆軟體公司的擔憂與私募信貸疑慮壓抑另類資管股價；BCRED 當季募資 10 億美元，低於前季 19 億與去年同期 37 億。
findings.source: Morningstar Financial Services: Concerns About AI Disruption and Private Credit Weigh on Sector
findings.excerpt: We downgraded many of our economic moat ratings on software firms in response to rapidly improving AI capabilities, with flow-through impacts on those firms’ pricing power, long-term growth prospects, and valuations.

note: 搜尋另見 Morningstar（AI 顛覆軟體公司衝擊另類資管持股與私募信貸）與 tokenization 對私募市場費用的預測性文章，僅取得摘要無逐字原文，列為 clues。tokenization 資料多為廠商/預測性質。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
